title: 12-apps: waypoint /routes resource (18.3.3)
description: spec/12-apps.md 18.3.3 defines ordered waypoint routes {id,name,waypoints[],distance_m,created,creator} with /routes, /routes/{id} using the same CRUD pattern as waypoints. No /routes waypoint resource exists in Python, Rust, or C (only routing-table /status/routes). Listed as planned P2 in docs/spec-chapter-breakdowns.md:1583-1585. Suggested placement: mirror waypoints.py / coap_waypoints.c. See docs/spec-coverage/12-apps.md R-12-027.
